simple.meaning: גָּרַשׁ (gârash) appears 47 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with flocks.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 16 more, beginning at Genesis 3:24. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, flock, land, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גָּרַשׁ (H1644) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows גָּרַשׁ through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: גָּרַשׁ (gârash) / H1644 is tracked through Genesis 3:24, Genesis 4:14, Genesis 21:10, Exodus 2:17. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.
